data.name: Chapter 1: The Pond
entries: The village of Reedmoor sits beside a pond that glows at night.
Lanterns bob over the dark water. Something croaks, loud as a drum.

entries.name: The Glowing Pond
entries: A {@creature Glimmer Toad|TST} rests on a lily pad. Roll {@dice 1d4} toads.

entries.name: Running the Pond
entries: Let the players choose where to search first.

entries.name: Inside the Shrine
entries: A {@spell Test Spark|TST} scorch mark covers the wall. It deals {@damage 2d6} fire damage.
